sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (light from above, dim inside a tunnel)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70, then if LEFT sees a wall turn left 20°, else if RIGHT sees a wall turn right 20°, else call driveInTheDark; if LLIGHT is not below 70, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle stop, else call followLine.
followLine: curve left on black, else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel in the dark without hitting its walls, turning away when a wall comes in front.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim, inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim light: it checks the side obstacle sensors

decision_points.condition: in dim light: LEFT sees a wall, then RIGHT sees a wall

branches.outcome: LEFT sees a wall: it turns left 20°
RIGHT sees a wall (LEFT doesn't): it turns right 20°
no wall on either side: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim light: it drives forward at 30 % without end

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it drives forward; if its left sensor sees a wall it turns left 20°, if its right sensor sees a wall it turns right 20°, otherwise it drives on.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a tunnel in dim light, facing along it, with nothing in front of it and the tunnel's walls along its sides.
scenarios.trigger: It drives forward and the tunnel bends, so a wall comes in front of its left or right half.
scenarios.title: Drives through a tunnel without hitting its walls
assumptions: That it should get through the tunnel, not only stand still.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from a wall in front and drives through the tunnel without hitting its walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It goes to stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead it stops, else it follows the line, curving left on black and right on the floor.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in bright light, on a plain floor or on a line, in front of a wall or not.
scenarios.title: In bright light

uncertainties: In bright light the program follows the line and stops at a wall; your sentence says nothing about that, so those situations have no expected behaviour.

The light falls gradually under a tunnel's roof: the 70 % switch happens about 7.5 cm inside the opening and 7.5 cm before the exit, so the robot keeps following a line under the first and last centimetres.
A 20° turn takes time and moves the robot, so in a bend it may still see the wall for a moment and turn again.
